core_theme: Specification、Repository 与 Query Object 是三个不同职责：命名判据、控制持久化访问、表达一次查询；校验、授权、规则引擎是各自独立的边界
reader_takeaway: 读者能按「什么需要名字、什么需要执行、什么需要边界」为每个查询与规则选择最小合适的抽象
summary_angle: 把「三个职责模块 + 一条独立边界」压成一张等距场景封面：判据模块、访问模块、查询模块在同一数据流上分工协作，外围一道独立边界圈住校验与授权，体现按职责而非按模式数量选型

final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: .NET 里 Specification、Repository 与 Query Object 的三个不同职责——命名判据、控制持久化访问、表达一次查询，外围的校验与授权是独立边界。The reader should quickly feel that this is about three cooperating responsibility modules and one separate boundary, not about which pattern replaces another. Summary angle: 等距场景中三个职责模块沿同一条数据流分层协作：上层判据模块（如印章），中层访问模块（带受控出入口），底层查询模块（输出投影与分页结果）；三者外围一道独立栏板，与它们保持距离。Narrative flow: layered reveal. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration. Information blocks: 1) contrast: top module naming criteria, like a seal or boolean switch; visible label「命名判据」. 2) mechanism: middle module controlling persistence access, with a controlled gateway; visible label「访问边界」. 3) mechanism: bottom module expressing a database query, outputting projection and page results; visible label「查询形状」. 4) takeaway: a separate boundary board around the three modules, at a distance; visible label「独立边界」. Main metaphor: three responsibility modules cooperating along one data flow, with an independent boundary board around them. Subject: the three layered isometric modules (criteria, access, query) connected by a clear data-flow direction. Composition/framing: isometric space with hierarchical relationship, legible in a wide cover. Style/medium: combine isometric conceptual systems scene with the selected visual style descriptor: black-and-white printmaking look, carved textures, bold shadows, high contrast, poster-like but no title text. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: black, white, shades of gray, printmaking carved texture. Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips by default, max 4 when strictly necessary: 「命名判据」「访问边界」「查询形状」「独立边界」. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no real system diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: 彩色渐变、霓虹、浮动芯片、代码雨、通用机器人、HUD 浮层。
